_readme: Input for scripts/verify_cart_paths.py. One entry per path a buyer can take (main, main+U1, main+D1, ... with U2/D2), per colour and per quantity tier you sell. Variant ids come from scripts/catalogue_dump.py. expect_total is the cart subtotal you expect in store currency: with bundle products priced directly it equals your funnel price; with an automatic discount the cart shows catalogue price and the discount only appears at checkout, so leave it out or set the catalogue sum.
